title: Campus health says coverage will lapse
scenario: A message claims to be from the university health plan and says your coverage lapses tomorrow unless you re-enter insurance and payment details. It includes the correct semester dates.

answers.A: Check your current coverage status in the insurer portal before entering anything.
answers.B: Use the link because the semester dates and university logo are correct.
answers.C: Open the university health-insurance portal directly or contact student health through a known channel.

explanation: Public academic calendars make timing easy to imitate. Coverage status should be verified in the actual account.
